ctx.x: JC, did Mamie Smith record any of your songs?

Yes, she did. In later years, she recorded songs of mine before, it would have been impossible for her to do when she was with Perry Bradford, because he was sitting in the driver's seat, and anything that she recorded, it would either be his or a part of his. So now that she belonged to our organization, and she wanted to record before she cut out for the green land, why, she recorded a couple of Andy Razaf and my songs.
Uh huh. I understand there was
